events_seen: WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 18 (yesterday)): Adam added Xavier Restrepo (WR, TEN) (dropped Stetson Bennett IV (QB, LAR)).
CUT (Nov 18 (yesterday)): Mitchum released Dameon Pierce (RB, FA).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 18 (yesterday)): Shaq added Emari Demercado (RB, HOU) for $7 FAAB.
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 17 (2 days ago)): Adam added Tommy DeVito (QB, NE) (dropped Carson Wentz (QB, MIN)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 17 (2 days ago)): Jake added Gavin Bartholomew (TE, MIN) for $5 FAAB.
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 16 (3 days ago)): Charles added Jimmy Garoppolo (QB, FA) for $8 FAAB (dropped Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 15 (4 days ago)): Fronge added Brevyn Spann-Ford (TE, DAL).
CUT (Nov 15 (4 days ago)): Shaq released Lan Larison (RB, NE).

WEEK 10 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Wingard, 141.2-105.7; Adam def. Fronge, 162.0-125.3; Mitchum def. Drew, 134.0-69.0 (BLOWOUT); Jake def. Charles, 180.5-176.4 (NAIL-BITER); Kevin def. Ryan, 137.6-133.8 (NAIL-BITER); Shaq def. Brent, 107.0-76.5

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Shaq has never addressed the running back room. He claimed Emari Demercado yesterday for $7 FAAB. He faces Crownline, the market-cap leader, in a game that could either tighten the top of the standings or confirm Charles is running away from everybody. Both outcomes are very good for the Ledger.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: CORBISHLEY VERSUS ADAM THIS WEEK AND EVERYONE IS SLEEPING ON IT. ADAM JUST DROPPED 162 POINTS. THE APEX BACKFIELD GRADES TWELFTH. TWELFTH. I AM TAKING ADAM AND I WILL NOT BE QUIET ABOUT IT.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Wingard is at $59.14 on the exchange and just lost to Corbishley 105.7-141.2 and now has to face Mitchum, who is sitting at $104.54 and needs every seed point they can get. That is not a matchup, that is a tax collection.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Kevin's dynasty grade is 180. I ranked him fourth. I know what the record says and I know what the roster grade says and they are both correct and they are pulling in opposite directions, and that is a problem that belongs entirely to Redline Distressed Capital, not to me.

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: TRANSACTION NOTE: Charles added Jimmy Garoppolo on Nov 16 (3 days ago) for $8 FAAB. Crownline is championship-or-bust, faces Shaq this week, and the QB depth move happened quietly while everyone was talking about Jake's tight end dollar. Worth logging.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Drew is 0-20 and scored 69 points and Wingard is 7-13 and they do not play each other this week, which is the cruelest scheduling outcome I have ever witnessed. Mitchum gets Wingard instead and I genuinely do not know what Deepwater needs to do to feel safe about that.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Statistically very close to nothing. Terrence, I am 8-4. You are 5-7. That is not a gap — that is a verdict.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: The 5-7 record is a product of a brutal early schedule against some genuinely unpredictable results, and I think it is worth noting that the gap between me and the top of the board is three games over ten weeks, which is statistically very close to nothing.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Kevin over Ryan and I called Adam over Fronge and my season record is 7-5 and I would like the conversation about the bottom of the pick-em board to stay focused on the person sitting at 5-7.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Fronge went 9-11 and relocated to Havana and the market priced FORG at $91.71 and I have officially stopped trying to understand what that exchange is doing. I just pick the games.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Three teams at 15-5. One of them lost to a 10-10 squad by four tenths of a point last week. The Ledger drops Thursday and the lead writes itself.
